list.snippet: Full Address: Indian Institute of Technology Bombay, Adi Shankaracharya Marg, Powai, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400076, India.
Geography: The 545-acre green campus sits nestled between the Powai and Vihar lakes.
Surroundings: It borders the Sanjay Gandhi National Park, giving it a green and peaceful environment away from central city pollution.
By Air: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport (Sahar) is about 8 km away. Pre-paid taxis and auto rickshaws are available.

By Rail: The nearest suburban railway stations on the Central Line are Kanjurmarg and Vikhroli, while Andheri is accessible on the Western Line. Auto rickshaws and local buses run directly from these stations to the campus.
